summary: Frontend-only verification of 3 changes: (1) alert-bell dark-mode fix, (2) Reports Custom date range + pagination, (3) SupportSheet split into 13 files. All primary flows PASS. Bell color correctly switches from rgb(23,22,19) [C.ink3] in light mode to rgb(243,237,227) [D.text] in dark mode. Custom date range modal: all 5 testIDs present (reports-custom-banner/start/end/apply/cancel), validation error 'Start date must be on or before end date.' appears, banner shows selected range, reopen prefills prior dates, cancel closes without changes. Pagination Show-more buttons correctly HIDDEN when no transactions (subcatBars.length and merchants.length both 0). SupportSheet split: 13 files under /app/frontend/src/support/, thin 154-line SupportSheet.tsx router — no red screens, no console errors, all mode testIDs verified. All hub testIDs present (support-close, support-help-* x5, support-new, support-list, support-visit-website, powered-by-jaleter). Bug/Privacy/Delete/Billing/BankHelp/New/List/Detail modes all render with correct testIDs. Delete-submit is aria-disabled=true until 'DELETE' typed then flips to false. Admin flow: support-admin visible only for admin, admin-filter-* chips work, admin-status-{open,in_progress,waiting_on_user,resolved,closed} + admin-note + admin-note-submit + support-reply + support-reply-submit all present and functional. Regression checks (Legacy 30yr + cumulative-toggle, More screen more-visit-jaleter + powered-by-jaleter) PASS.

seed_data_creation: None. Used pre-seeded alex+test1@jaleter.app (11 support tickets) and support@jaleter.com admin. Did not seed transactions to test Show-more pagination with populated lists — verified only the hidden-when-empty branch.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bell test: run `getComputedStyle(el).color` on all descendants of [data-testid='home-bell']. Light mode = rgb(23,22,19); Dark mode = rgb(243,237,227). To toggle theme: bell tap opens Settings sheet -> click [data-testid='settings-appear-Dark'] or -Light. Support flow: user login -> home-bell -> settings-support (must scrollIntoView first inside settings scroll view). To reach AdminMode: only support@jaleter.com/Tarik0731! shows the support-admin row. To click an admin ticket row (which currently lacks testID), use `page.get_by_text(subject).first`. Reports pagination: seed 15+ txns to see reports-more-{subcats,merchants} appear. Custom-date-modal is a plain Modal — the TextInputs live inside the modal only; the reports-custom-banner testID exists on the page-level banner AND is reused as the same testID inside the modal on iteration 25 code (banner and start/end textinputs are all inside the same Modal wrapper — verified no conflict). Bottom tabs on this app: Home/Budget/Transactions/Net Worth/Legacy — NO 'More' tab, More is reached via [data-testid='home-profile'] avatar.
